traits.height_typical_m.note: Jepson 1925, Dicentra formosa, Fig. 404, p. 405: naked scape-like flowering stems 8 in to 18 in high, a little taller than the leaves (Abrams vol. 2, p. 234, gives the basal leaves as 3 dm to 5 dm long but no scape height).

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a delicate herb with lacy, fern-like, blue-green leaves and arching stems hung with pink, heart-shaped flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.4 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: blue-green leaves; pink flowers. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): four pink petals by hand (in two pairs; the drawing has no joined heart-shaped corolla) above two sepals, six stamens and a pistil of two carpels, from the characters of Papaveraceae and Dicentra by the rules at the flowering plants.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
